name: Chabris
description: Son of Gothoniel; one of the governors of Bethulia, present with Ozias and Charmis when Achior was brought to the city, when Judith sent for the governors, and when Judith and her maid went out from the gate

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
